page.title: Accounts
page.description: Operator accounts persisted in the control plane and applied to the engine. Block an account or group to halt orders via the kill switch.

filters.maskHelp: Use * as a wildcard. For example, desk-* matches desk-alpha and desk-risk; choose starts with, ends with, or exact for stricter matching.

groups.heading: Groups
groups.defaultGroupNote: All accounts without an assigned group.

columnDescriptions.group: This column shows the account group code and display title.
columnDescriptions.accounts: This column shows how many accounts belong to the group.
columnDescriptions.positions: This column shows how many open position rows belong to the group.
columnDescriptions.status: This column shows whether the group is active or blocked.
columnDescriptions.notes: This column shows the operator notes stored on the group.
columnDescriptions.actions: This column contains row actions for filtering, sharing, and deleting the group.

filters.advancedDescription: Search group notes, block reason, and position counts. These filters apply together with code, status, and account count.

actions.positionsTitle: Open positions filtered by this group

columnDescriptions.account: This column shows the account code and display title.
columnDescriptions.group: This column shows the group assigned to the account.
columnDescriptions.positions: This column shows how many position rows are stored for the account.
columnDescriptions.status: This column shows whether the account is active or blocked.
columnDescriptions.notes: This column shows the operator notes stored on the account.
columnDescriptions.actions: This column contains row actions for positions, trading, policies, audit, and deletion.

filters.advancedDescription: Search account block reason and position counts. These filters apply together with code, status, and selected group.

links.positions: Positions — spot limits for this account

actions.positionsTitle: Open positions filtered by this account

empty.title: No accounts
empty.hintFiltered: No accounts are assigned to this group.
empty.hintEmpty: Create the first account to start applying risk limits to it.

origins.account: Account currency is set on the account
origins.default: Account currency uses the default tier

createAccount.title: Create account
createAccount.description: Create an account in the control plane and optionally assign it to a group.
createAccount.codeHint: Up to 64 printable characters, no leading or trailing whitespace.
createAccount.groupHint: Choose an existing group or type a new code. Leave blank to create an ungrouped account.
createAccount.currencyHint: Without a currency, realized P&L for this account is not computed.

createGroup.title: Create group
createGroup.currencyHint: Without a currency, realized P&L for accounts in this group is not computed unless an account currency is set.
createGroup.notesPlaceholder: Accounts belonging to the US equity trading desks.
createGroup.notesHint: Reference notes — stored in the control plane only, not sent to the engine.

editCurrency.title: Edit account currency
editCurrency.blockedHint: This account has balance or P&L rows. The backend will reject a change that would alter its effective currency.
editCurrency.currencyHint: Clear the field to inherit from group and default tiers. Without an effective account currency, realized P&L for this account is not computed.

editGroupCurrency.title: Edit group currency
editGroupCurrency.defaultDescription: Set the reserved default group currency.
editGroupCurrency.blockedHint: The backend rejects changes that would alter effective currency for member accounts with balance or P&L rows.

blockAccount.description: Blocking halts new orders for this account. A reason is required and is recorded in the audit log.
blockAccount.reasonPlaceholder: Kill-switch: risk limit breach during incident #42

unblockAccount.title: Unblock account?
unblockAccount.descriptionSuffix: will accept new orders again. This is recorded in the audit log.

blockGroup.description: Blocking halts new orders for all accounts in this group. A reason is required and is recorded in the audit log.
blockGroup.reasonPlaceholder: Kill-switch: risk limit breach during incident #42

unblockGroup.title: Unblock group?
unblockGroup.descriptionSuffix: accounts will accept new orders again. This is recorded in the audit log.

blockDetails.description: Full block reason and the nearest audit record for this block.

deleteGroup.title: Delete group?
deleteGroup.descriptionSuffix: will be permanently removed. Accounts currently assigned to this group will have their group assignment cleared.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account?
deleteAccount.descriptionSuffix: will be permanently removed. Dependent trading records are deleted only after explicit force confirmation.

editGroup.description: Update the group id and display title.

editAccount.description: Update the account id and display title.

editGroupNotes.description: Reference notes stored in the control plane. Not sent to the engine and have no effect on risk evaluation.

editAccountNotes.description: Reference notes stored in the control plane. Not sent to the engine and have no effect on risk evaluation.

assignGroup.description: Choose an existing group or type a new id. Leave blank to clear the group assignment.
